original_benchmark.notes: 1000 charts x (4 descriptive + 1 reasoning) questions with public answers. Upstream queries MLLMs directly (src/generate_lib) and grades with a GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) judge. That model is retired; the adapter defaults to gpt-4o-2024-08-06 on both sides.
1323 charts x 5 questions; ground-truth answers are intentionally withheld (null) upstream, so the split cannot be graded locally.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity subset: 100 charts x 5 questions = 500 tasks (10%), sampled with seed 42 (--split parity). Parity uses the charxiv-direct agent (matched single-call generation, see README); parity_costs is an estimate from token counts of the logged requests at list prices (gpt-4o-mini generation about $5 and gpt-4o judge about $2.4 per side for 3 runs, both sides). The verifier runs in a separate container (environment_mode = separate).
